floworks

genstaq.ai
genstaq.ai

Key use cases include personalized email drafting, where natural language models or pre-set templates generate tailored emails for tasks like repayment reminders and product offers. The platform also supports document reconciliation for loan origination and compliance, using AI-powered classification to detect inconsistencies. Additionally, it deploys Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engines to pull real-time data and build complex agentic workflows for automating tasks across pre- and post-sales scenarios, such as customer onboarding and inquiry management.

genvr
genvr

The platform also fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) for the Indian context. intellosync
intellosync

The product includes an AI-based CLM and a contract review MS Word plugin. Its flagship feature, IntelloSync Co-Pilot, is an LLM-based legal assistant that helps in contract operations, capable of extracting over 200 fields from contracts in seconds using AI models and Google OCR. The platform integrates with tools like DocuSign, Zoho Sign, and Adobe Sign, and syncs with ERP and CRM platforms. It enables fast contract execution with inter- and intra-company collaboration on MS Office, offering advanced features like clause improvement, keyword contract searches, and the ability to add new clauses. Built using models like Llama, Mistral, and GPT 3.5, the platform is trained on a vast dataset of contracts, regulations, and compliance information from India, the USA, and Singapore, ensuring legally relevant outputs via its RAG framework.

The platform provides granular SKU-level insights and sends notifications to store reps for action. phot.ai

Phot.ai integrates with popular platforms like ChatGPT, Shopify, Adobe, and Canva via APIs and plugins, using advanced tech such as Stable Diffusion and proprietary AI models for object detection, OCR, colorization, and image upscaling.

storefox.ai
storefox.ai

Storefox.ai (formerly Supereps.ai) transforms retail organizations by leveraging customer interactions to increase business efficiency, improve decision-making and accelerate revenue growth. The Conversation Intelligence Platform uses proprietary artificial intelligence technology to enable brands to capture, understand and act on all customer interactions in a single, integrated, easy to use platform.

tranzmeo
tranzmeo

Tranzmeo offers AI-powered solutions for asset monitoring using fiber optic sensing. Their system monitors pipelines, railways, and power cables for intrusions and anomalies by detecting 20+ activities such as manual and mechanized digging, tunneling, and even livestock movement. By utilizing backscattered light within fiber optics, the platform creates virtual sensors every 0.68m, allowing real-time detection of changes in temperature, pressure, and strain over distances up to 100 km without the need for field power. Tranzmeo’s AI solution, OneView, overlays this fiber sensing technology to pinpoint activities with location accuracy under 1 meter.

tvasta
tvasta

Their product suite includes gantry-based 3D printers in various sizes, tailored for R&D, offsite, and onsite printing needs. Equipped with multi-axial robotic arms and customizable motion systems, the printers are designed for versatility and ease of use. The company also offers related accessories like aggregate pumps, mixers, and 3D printing materials. Their R&D center focuses on developing advanced building materials through specialized labs for concrete, cement, durability, and shrinkage, supporting innovation in 3D printed construction.

unscript

The platform uses proprietary models for video creation and integrates fine-tuned models like Mistral for script generation. It allows customization of facial expressions, speech, and background elements, with video lengths typically ranging from 2-5 minutes. Additionally, it provides analytics on customer engagement and viewership.
